description: Where Prompt Shields asks for stream usage with stream_options.include_usage (#389). gateway_providers: gateway provider ids that forward stream_options verbatim and return the OpenAI chunk stream unchanged (gateway/src/middlewares/psStreamUsage.ts DEFAULT_PROVIDERS). sdk_hosts: API hosts the SDK's OpenAI client adds it for (prompt_shields/streaming.py STREAM_USAGE_HOSTS); a leading '.' matches any subdomain. Azure OpenAI (provider azure-openai, *.openai.azure.com) only from azure_min_api_version on, or the dateless v1 API. Both add more with PS_STREAM_INCLUDE_USAGE_HOSTS (exact hostnames, e.g. a vLLM server).
